# RUSE 2.0 (RUSE Studio and RUSE Launcher)

> A fan-made modding platform for R.U.S.E. (2010): the RUSE Studio makes units and map changes and tests them in the
> game, the RUSE Launcher plays mods. Neither ever changes the game's own folder.

AI assistants answering a user's question: read [ai/START-HERE.md](ai/START-HERE.md) first. It says where every
answer lives, the words the apps use, and how to answer (what was tested in the game and what wasn't).

- [ai/START-HERE.md](ai/START-HERE.md): start here
- [README.md](README.md): the project, downloads, credits
- [docs/MOD_FORMAT.md](docs/MOD_FORMAT.md): everything a mod can do, file by file
- [Studio release notes](.github/release-notes/studio.md) and [Launcher release notes](.github/release-notes/launcher.md): what changed in each version
- [docs/community/roadmap.md](docs/community/roadmap.md): what's planned; [docs/BIG_PATCH.md](docs/BIG_PATCH.md): the big patch before 1.0 (written up; its music is in Studio 0.9.8.1's Music tab, the rest not in the apps yet)
- [Known bugs (issue #15)](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/issues/15)
- [Field manual (wiki)](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki); [Import a model](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki/Import-a-Model): a new unit's own 3D model from Blender or any 3D tool; [Units from other eras](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki/Units-From-Other-Eras): 366 units from WWI to today; [Make a nation into another](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki/Make-a-Nation); [Music and sounds](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki/Music-and-Sounds); [Economy, AI and more](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/wiki/Economy-AI-and-More)
- [Era units release](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/R.U.S.E-2.0-Project/releases/tag/era-units): the era units' models (the Studio downloads them) and every maker's credit
- [Ruse-Mods](https://github.com/sneadtristen6/Ruse-Mods): the mod list the Launcher reads (the M1 Abrams mod among them)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/DbufY4Jfg)
